description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'InterviewAttachmentSearchFilterParams' used for filtering search parameters related to interview attachments in the recruitment module. It extends a base FilterParams class and specifies allowed sort fields along with getter and setter for interview ID.

classes.name: InterviewAttachmentSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for encapsulating search filter parameters specifically for interview attachments within the recruitment module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets the default sort field to 'attachment.interviewId'.

methods.name: getInterviewId
methods.description: Returns the interview ID used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setInterviewId
methods.description: Sets the interview ID filter criterion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the 'InterviewAttachmentSearchFilterParams' object and sets the default sort field.

methods.name: getInterviewId
methods.description: Returns the current interview ID filter value.

methods.name: setInterviewId
methods.description: Sets the interview ID filter value.
